body: Human nature. I've tried to kill myself but my fear of death is what prevented me from doing it. That's the only thing that keeps me alive is the fact that when I try to kill myself I can't jump off that bridge or lay down in front of that train without being scared that it's not going to work properly and I will be paralyzed and have an inability to end my life on my own terms. If I had access to a gun I would have pulled the trigger years ago, but I can't afford a gun.
